'''Mok Cadrak''' was as [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Cadrak was one of Riboga's lead enforcers and following Riboga's return to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], the Hutt sent Cadrak to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], to attack a number of criminal gang's that had refused to submit to Riboga. Cadrak lead a group of 12 thugs in an attack on members of the [[Lurid Gundarks]] gang, but he was defeated by the Gundarks and the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
